newsitem.title: UK: Racal agrees alliance for 2 bln stg MOD bid.
newsitem.headline: Racal agrees alliance for 2 bln stg MOD bid.

text.p: Racal Electronics Plc on Tuesday announced an alliance with the rival ITT Defence and Siemens team in the race to win the British Ministry of Defence Bowmans communications contract worth 2.0 billion pounds ($3.37 billion).

The electronics to telecoms group said its Racal Radio unit had signed an agreement in principle with ITT and Siemens and submitted the joint proposals to the MOD. Both teams have spent tens of millions of pounds developing their bids. The move was revealed just as Racal announced a slump in half year pretax profits to 21.1 million from 30.1 million, after a profit warning on Monday.
Shares in the company lurched sharply lower on Monday after the group unveiled that first half profits would be 21 million pounds, about 20 million below expectations.

The company blamed the Radio Group division, responsible for the Bowman bid, for the poor outlook. Tuesday's results also showed a 10 million stg charge hitting the data products unit. The dividend was unchanged at 2.10 pence and turnover rose 20 percent to 602 million.

While the results blow had been flagged, news on the Bowman link-up was unexpected. Racal has been focusing on the contract to re-equip the British Armed Forces battlefield communications for several years. The export market for the winning consortium is expected to be another two billion pounds of business on top of the contract value.

David Elsbury, group chief executive, said of the alliance in a statement: "As an Anglo-American industrial partnership, this alliance would employ the best available UK and U.S. technologies." The Racal team called Yeoman and the ITT/Siemens team named Crowwbow, will combine technical, manufacturing and production resources. ($1=.5936 Pound)
